column1: # Receiver replies the Swift StreamReceiveWire encodes and Kotlin RtmpReceiveReply decodes.
# Big-endian: u32 outbound length, outbound, u16 event count, events [u8 kind, u32 length, body].
# Kinds: 1 publish, 2 videoConfig [codec, enhanced, record], 3 videoFrame [codec, key, u32 dts,
# i32 cts, data], 4 audioConfig, 5 audioFrame [u32 ts, data], 6 unpublished, 7 failed [reason],
